scope: Characterization of the legacy standalone HTML tools. This file is descriptive and must not be used as a clinical source of truth.

logic.formula: sum selected values; missing categories contribute 0
logic.conditional: comparison is shown only when both comparison scores parse as integers

ambiguities: The UI calculates a partial score when categories are unanswered instead of rejecting incomplete input.

expect.comparison-row: 1 min: 55 min: 8 5 → 8 ↑ Improving Good recovery, positive response to resuscitation

logic.formula: classify by the highest systolic or diastolic threshold
logic.conditional: risk count: 0 low, 1-2 moderate, 3-4 high, 5+ very high

warnings: hypertensive crisis directs immediate medical attention
ambiguities: HTML min/max constraints are not revalidated by the JavaScript entry point.

characterization.alert: Please enter both systolic and diastolic values

logic.precision: BMI rounded to one decimal with toFixed(1)

ambiguities: Direct invocation permits empty/zero values and can display NaN or Infinity; browser required/min validation only applies on form submit.

logic.formula: simplified Framingham points and simplified ASCVD coefficients; overall risk combines maximum score with modifiers
logic.conditional: family history, diabetes, smoking and other factors can raise overall classification

sources: UI labels the algorithms Framingham and ASCVD but contains simplified local implementations
ambiguities: Not a validated reference implementation; ethnicity and statin inputs are only partly or not used.

characterization.alert: Please fill in all required fields

logic.formula: sum six sign scores; count additional symptoms separately
thresholds: 3+ additional symptoms raises wording one level unless severe
logic.conditional: fluid recommendation changes for adult versus other age groups

warnings: moderate starts ORS immediately; severe starts urgent IV guidance
ambiguities: Unanswered signs contribute zero and blank weight silently defaults to 10 kg.

logic.formula: minimum urgency number from checked signs and age-adjusted vital thresholds, then pain escalation

warnings: P1 and P2 represent life-threatening or time-critical care
ambiguities: The required age is not validated by performTriage; blank values become NaN and default to adult vital branches.

logic.precision: balance/kg one decimal; urine/kg/hour two decimals
logic.conditional: normal urine minimum is 0.4 for age >=65, otherwise 0.5; condition adjusts recommendations

ambiguities: Age 0 is allowed by HTML but rejected by the JavaScript truthiness check.

characterization.alert: Please enter patient weight and age

ambiguities: Partial selection can generate scores below the clinical scale minimum of 3.

logic.formula: derive age from current date and compare schedule due dates with today
logic.conditional: schedule and additional recommendations depend on country, age, sex, risk category and conditions
logic.time_dependency: current wall clock; tests freeze Date

sources: country schedule names are shown in UI; verify schedule data clinically before migration
ambiguities: Schedule correctness and jurisdictional freshness require clinical review.

logic.formula: single=min(mg/kg × kg, medication max single); daily=single × frequency
logic.precision: weight one decimal, doses one decimal
thresholds: medication-specific dose, maximum single dose, maximum daily dose and age warnings
logic.conditional: custom uses entered dosage/frequency; standard drugs load preset values

ambiguities: The calculator is educational and preset doses require pharmacist/clinical validation.

characterization.alert: Please fill in all required fields

logic.formula: numeric/FACES/PQRST selected score; BPS=sum 3 domains; FLACC=sum 5 domains
logic.conditional: recommendations depend on age, duration and scale

warnings: moderate and severe pain escalation guidance
ambiguities: An untouched numeric scale reports a missing-assessment alert; BPS and FLACC instead sum unanswered components as zero.

characterization.alert: Please complete the pain assessment by selecting a score or answering all questions.

logic.formula: convert age to months and F to C; classify by age, temperature and danger signs; medication=15 mg/kg paracetamol and 10 mg/kg ibuprofen
logic.precision: temperature one decimal; doses rounded to whole mg
logic.conditional: weight is estimated when absent; ibuprofen only from 6 months

warnings: young infant fever and any danger sign require urgent evaluation
ambiguities: Age 0 is allowed by HTML but rejected by the JavaScript truthiness check; estimated weight is a rough fallback.

logic.formula: LMP due=LMP+280d; conception due=conception+266d; ultrasound derives LMP by subtracting gestational days then +280d
logic.conditional: method-specific date derivation and milestone generation
logic.time_dependency: current wall clock; tests freeze Date

ambiguities: Cycle length affects conception estimate but not due date; invalid ultrasound weeks can pass because parseInt yields NaN rather than undefined.

characterization.alert: Please enter the first day of your last menstrual period

logic.formula: area=length×width; severity, infection risk and healing potential use counts plus tissue/depth/exudate conditions
logic.precision: floating dimensions, no displayed numeric rounding
thresholds: major: bone, >=3 infection signs, depth>3, area>25 with depth>1, or purulent
moderate: >=1 sign, necrotic/slough, depth>1, area>10, heavy exudate, or >=2 risk factors
logic.conditional: care changes by severity, infection risk, healing potential and tetanus status
logic.checklist_completion: unchecked items are treated as absent; no completeness validation

warnings: major/high infection risk immediate care; overdue/never/unknown tetanus warning
ambiguities: All fields are optional and an empty form produces a minor unspecified wound.
